title: Architectural Improvements
description: Major refactor introducing centralized API client for improved reliability and maintainability

items.title: Centralized API Client
items.description: Introduced a new `apiClient` class that automatically handles authentication headers, CORS credentials, and error handling for all API requests. This prevents entire classes of bugs related to missing authentication headers.

items.title: Automatic Auth Header Injection
items.description: All API calls now automatically include the JWT authorization header from localStorage, eliminating the need to manually add headers in every fetch call.

items.title: Consistent Error Handling
items.description: Centralized error handling provides consistent error messages and makes it easier to add retry logic, logging, and other cross-cutting concerns.

items.title: Production Authentication Fixed
items.description: Resolved 401 Unauthorized errors in production by ensuring all API calls include proper authentication headers. This affected connections, chats, queries, and settings endpoints.

items.title: Cross-Origin Request Support
items.description: Fixed CORS configuration to properly allow Authorization headers in cross-origin requests between frontend and backend subdomains.

items.title: Reduced Code Duplication
items.description: Refactored API functions to use the centralized client, reducing code duplication and making the codebase more maintainable.

items.title: TypeScript Improvements
items.description: Added generic type support to API client methods for better type safety and IDE autocomplete.
